items.distractor_fact: 邻近城镇当天的气温是{D}摄氏度。
items.gloss_en: The neighboring town's temperature that day was {D} degrees Celsius.
items.entity_note: A different town's temperature reading, not the thermometer/place in the story.

items.distractor_fact: 另一件商品当天收盘时的价格是{D}元。
items.gloss_en: Another item's closing price that day was {D} yuan.
items.entity_note: A different item's price, not the item the story is about.

items.distractor_fact: 附近另一座水库同期的水位是{D}米。
items.gloss_en: A nearby different reservoir's water level over the same period was {D} meters.
items.entity_note: A different reservoir, not the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: 另一架无人机同一时间的飞行高度是{D}米。
items.gloss_en: Another drone's altitude at the same time was {D} meters.
items.entity_note: A different drone, not the one being tracked in the story.

items.gloss_en: Another group's budget for this activity was {D} yuan.

items.distractor_fact: 另一个账户本月存入的金额是{D}元。
items.gloss_en: Another account's deposit amount this month was {D} yuan.
items.entity_note: A different bank account, not the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: 隔壁店铺本月的收入是{D}元。
items.gloss_en: The neighboring shop's revenue this month was {D} yuan.

items.distractor_fact: 另一支球队本赛季打入的球数是{D}个。

items.distractor_fact: 另一位投资者本季度的收益是{D}元。

items.gloss_en: Another player's stroke count in a round at a different golf course was {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: A different player on a different, unstated-par course, not the player/course in the story.

items.gloss_en: On a different line, another train's actual arrival moment that day was the {D}-th minute counted from midnight.
items.entity_note: A different train on a different line with its own unstated timetable, not the train in the story.

items.gloss_en: On a different route, another flight's actual departure moment that day was the {D}-th minute counted from midnight.
items.entity_note: A different flight on a different route with its own unstated schedule, not the flight in the story.

items.gloss_en: The elevator in the building next door is currently at floor number {D}.
items.entity_note: A different building with its own unstated ground-floor reference, not the building in the story.

items.gloss_en: In a different match, Team C scored {D} goals.
